interest: Shows a Washington sheriff seeking lily-bulb propagation contracts with occupied Japan via its new Board of Trade.
keywords: Division of Occupied Areas Economic Affairs
overview: Croft asks State how to contract with Japanese growers to ship lily bulbs for propagation and return; Whitman directs him to Japan's Board of Trade (Bōeki-chō) and advises checking U.S. Agriculture Department re-import rules.

people.name: Elmer Hurd
people.role: Chief Civil Deputy of Pierce County, Washington

people.name: Roswell H. Whitman
people.role: Acting Chief, Division of Occupied Areas Economic Affairs, Department of State

subfiles.about: Inquiry from Pierce County Sheriff H. W. Croft regarding the procedure for contracting with Japanese growers or the Japanese Government to cultivate and propagate lily bulbs for return to the United States.
subfiles.from: H. W. Croft, Sheriff of Pierce County, Washington
subfiles.summary: Sheriff Croft asks State how to contract with Japanese growers to ship Lily of the Valley and Croft lily bulbs to Japan for cultivation and return the multiplied yield.
subfiles.title: Letter from H. W. Croft regarding bulb propagation in Japan
subfiles.to: Bureau of Foreign Affairs, Washington, D.C.

subfiles.about: Department of State reply advising H. W. Croft to contact the Japanese Board of Trade (Bōeki-chō) and consult the U.S. Department of Agriculture regarding lily bulb export and re-importation.
subfiles.from: Roswell H. Whitman, Acting Chief, Division of Occupied Areas Economic Affairs, Department of State
keywords: Division of Occupied Areas Economic Affairs
subfiles.summary: Whitman tells Croft to contact Japan's Board of Trade (Bōeki-chō) in Tokyo for a dealer familiar with propagation contracts, and to check re-import rules with the Agriculture Department.
subfiles.title: Letter from Roswell H. Whitman to H. W. Croft regarding lily bulb trade with Japan
subfiles.to: H. W. Croft, Sheriff of Pierce County, Washington
